about: Content-id ratchet exclusions. ignoredTables are FBDATA entries that hold tuning, geometry, catalogs or translations rather than content records (a dotted name also covers its nested tables). hooks are data ids the engine deliberately names, such as an event it triggers by id; their quoted occurrences are not counted. Every entry needs a reason.

ignoredTables.reason: Authored story registrations and compatibility references live in story modules; the shared campaign type has no historical id dispatch.
Display vocabulary; its keys are lexicon layers (base, eras, governments, faiths, cultures), not content records.
Deeds navigation and bounded renderer definitions; content membership is declared by each deed, not a hardcoded panel list.

hooks.reason: Interaction navigation category; quoted engine uses name the UI group, not a station ladder. The ladder shares its spelling.
